selection_rule: Apply baseline profiles to every build and activate overlays only from confirmed product facts, contracts, jurisdictions, or assurance targets.

profiles.name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
profiles.version: 2017 Trust Services Criteria with revised points of focus 2022
profiles.scope: Controls at service organizations; Security is required and other Trust Services categories are scoped as applicable.
profiles.external_result: SOC 2 report issued by a licensed CPA firm
profiles.applicability_note: Maintain readiness in every build. Never call SOC 2 a certification or claim completion from code evidence.

profiles.name: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Systems
profiles.scope: Organization-wide information security management system.
profiles.external_result: Certificate issued through an authorized certification process
profiles.applicability_note: Maintain readiness in every build; require licensed normative text for clause-level coverage.

profiles.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
profiles.scope: Organization-wide cybersecurity governance and outcomes.
profiles.applicability_note: Use as a governance outcome map, not as a product certification.

profiles.name: NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls
profiles.scope: Broad security and privacy control catalog for federal and high-assurance systems.
profiles.applicability_note: Tailor an applicable baseline; never imply every catalog control applies.

profiles.name: CIS Critical Security Controls
profiles.scope: Prioritized organizational and technical cyber safeguards.
profiles.applicability_note: Start with IG1 and raise to IG2 or IG3 from risk and business requirements; observe CIS licensing terms.

profiles.name: Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix
profiles.scope: Cloud provider and customer controls across the shared-responsibility model.
profiles.external_result: CSA STAR result when separately pursued
profiles.applicability_note: Internal use is permitted; commercial or consulting reuse may require a CSA license.

profiles.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework
profiles.scope: Secure software development practices covering preparation, protection, production, and vulnerability response.
profiles.applicability_note: Use as the mandatory SDLC backbone. Do not treat draft SSDF revisions as final.

profiles.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
profiles.scope: Web applications, APIs, services, and server-side application security.
profiles.applicability_note: Select and record the risk-appropriate verification level; do not default every system to Level 3.

profiles.name: OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard
profiles.scope: Native and hybrid mobile application security and privacy.
profiles.applicability_note: Pair with pinned MASTG and MASWE evidence. Do not use the retired MASVS L1/L2/R model as current.

profiles.name: ISO/IEC 27701 Privacy Information Management Systems
profiles.scope: Privacy management for PII controllers and processors.
profiles.external_result: Certificate issued through an authorized certification process
profiles.applicability_note: The 2025 edition is a standalone management-system standard; require licensed text for clause-level mapping.

profiles.name: ISO/IEC 27017 Cloud Security Controls
profiles.scope: Cloud-specific information security controls and shared responsibility.
profiles.external_result: Scope-specific assurance result when separately pursued
profiles.applicability_note: Supersedes the 2015 edition; require licensed text for clause-level mapping.

profiles.name: ISO/IEC 27018 Protection of PII in Public Clouds
profiles.scope: Protection of PII when a public-cloud provider acts as a PII processor.
profiles.external_result: Scope-specific assurance result when separately pursued
profiles.applicability_note: Confirm the provider/processor role and require licensed text for clause-level mapping.

profiles.name: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
profiles.scope: Trustworthy AI risk across design, development, deployment, and use.
profiles.applicability_note: Voluntary and outcome-based; use the Generative AI Profile where relevant and never present it as certification.

profiles.name: FIPS 140-3 Cryptographic Module Validation
profiles.scope: Validation requirements for cryptographic modules used in applicable government contexts.
profiles.external_result: Exact module/version/configuration listed on a valid CMVP certificate
profiles.applicability_note: Using approved algorithms does not make a module FIPS validated.

profiles.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
profiles.scope: Account data and systems that store, process, transmit, or can affect the cardholder-data environment.
profiles.external_result: Applicable SAQ, ROC, AOC, or acquirer-determined validation
profiles.applicability_note: Outsourcing payment collection may reduce scope but does not automatically eliminate it.

profiles.name: HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules
profiles.version: Current 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164 as of 2026-08-06
profiles.scope: PHI and ePHI handled by covered entities and business associates.
profiles.applicability_note: A consumer wellness app is not automatically covered. The 2025 Security Rule proposal was not final as of verification.

profiles.name: HITRUST CSF
profiles.scope: Tailored, certifiable security and privacy control framework used in healthcare and high-assurance markets.
profiles.applicability_note: Full use and certification require authorized HITRUST content, tooling, and processes.

profiles.name: FTC Safeguards Rule
profiles.version: 16 CFR Part 314 current through the 2023 amendment
profiles.scope: Customer information held by financial institutions under FTC jurisdiction and applicable service providers.
profiles.applicability_note: Scope depends on the entity and activity; service-provider flow-downs commonly apply.

profiles.name: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act
profiles.scope: Education records at institutions receiving U.S. Department of Education funds.
profiles.applicability_note: Vendors usually depend on the school-official/direct-control relationship; state student-privacy laws may add duties.

profiles.name: Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule
profiles.scope: Online personal information from children under 13.
profiles.applicability_note: The general compliance deadline for the 2025 amendments passed on 2026-04-22.

profiles.name: FBI Criminal Justice Information Services Security Policy
profiles.scope: Criminal Justice Information and systems connected under an agency agreement.
profiles.applicability_note: Agency and state addenda can be stricter than the national policy.

profiles.name: NIST SP 800-171 Protecting CUI in Nonfederal Systems
profiles.scope: Protection of Controlled Unclassified Information in nonfederal systems and organizations.
profiles.applicability_note: Contract text controls. Some current contracts and CMMC still expressly use Revision 2.

profiles.name: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
profiles.version: 32 CFR Part 170 effective 2024-12-16; DFARS implementation effective 2025-11-10
profiles.scope: DoD contractor systems handling Federal Contract Information or CUI.
profiles.external_result: Required self-assessment or C3PAO/DCMA assessment status for the contract level
profiles.applicability_note: The current model incorporates NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2; do not silently substitute Revision 3.

profiles.name: Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program
profiles.scope: Cloud offerings used by U.S. federal agencies.
profiles.external_result: FedRAMP certification/authorization and agency authorization as applicable
profiles.applicability_note: The Rev. 5 and FedRAMP 20x transition is dynamic; pin the exact machine-readable ruleset used.

profiles.name: EU General Data Protection Regulation
profiles.scope: Personal-data processing connected to EU/EEA establishment, offering, or monitoring.
profiles.applicability_note: Confirm personal-data processing, controller/processor role, territorial scope, and member-state supplements.

profiles.name: California Consumer Privacy Act and CPRA Regulations
profiles.scope: California consumer personal information for covered businesses and their service providers or contractors.
profiles.applicability_note: Check live statutory thresholds and phased cybersecurity-audit filing dates.

profiles.name: EU Network and Information Systems Directive 2
profiles.scope: Essential and important entities and named digital or ICT sectors.
profiles.applicability_note: Apply the relevant member-state transposition; requirements vary by country.

profiles.name: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act
profiles.scope: EU financial entities and designated critical ICT third-party providers.
profiles.applicability_note: A generic fintech vendor is not automatically directly regulated; contractual flow-downs may still apply.

profiles.name: EU Cyber Resilience Act
profiles.scope: Commercial products with digital elements placed on the EU market.
profiles.applicability_note: Vulnerability reporting starts 2026-09-11; full application begins 2027-12-11. Confirm scope and exemptions.

profiles.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
profiles.scope: Providers, deployers, importers, and distributors of AI systems or models connected to the EU.
profiles.external_result: Role- and risk-specific conformity or regulatory result
profiles.applicability_note: General application began 2026-08-02; obligations remain role-, risk-, and phase-dependent.
